Recently we’ve announced the upcoming MAJOR CHANGES. As you can remember, we’ve promised you a bunch of new content: CCTV, events marketing, energy supply changes and more.
Night events
Every night will be packed with action! Be prepared because anything can happen and you’ll have to make tough calls in a blink of an eye! ⚠️
Marketing events
Make sure that every single night your club is full of people. Gain recognition and spread the word about your mind blowing parties with the new event marketing system! 📣
Dancers and dance stations
Sometimes all it takes is a spark to fill the dancefloor with guests! The new employee- dancer will show them the best moves using the new object- dance station! 💃
Slot machines
A little activity for all the party people who need a moment of rest. Slot machines- arcades known all around the world will undoubtedly make for a good additional activity in your clubs! 🎮
CCTV
With addition of the brand new CCTV system making sure that all the troublemakers will leave the club immediately has never been easier! 📹
Energy

The last bill for the energy left you speechless? You look for some way to spend less money? Check out the new energy management system where you can see and adjust how much power all the decorations and appliances need! 💡
Bar supply

A gentleman themed bar? A beer party? Any theme is now available for you. Manage the stock of alcohol available at the bar to make it match the party even more! 🍷 (Keep in mind that some guests may not like it when your bar is short of some particular drink)

notes.title: As you can see there’s a lot of new content for you to enjoy! We’re sure that these new features will make your parties and clubs even better! 😎

items.text: We’re grateful for all of your feedback and what you tell us does matter. This helps us know which aspects of the game should we work on so make sure to leave us your opinions on Steam or on our discord! 👇
See you soon,
Disco Simulator Team

First of all, we’d like to thank everyone for your feedback! ❤️‍ Thank you all! Since the release of the game, the amount of ideas you gave us was simply mind blowing. Influenced by your enthusiasm towards our game, we’d like to announce a huge content update! 💪 The upcoming changes are bound to make the gameplay even more satisfying so without further ado, let’s take a look at what’s to come! 🤩
Sometimes unexpected events can really catch you off guard and force you to take an immediate action out of your comfort zone. Are you prepared to face whatever the night brings? 🤔
A brand new employee available to hire in your clubs! Hire dancers to boost your economy and meet the expectations of even the most needy customers. Watch out, those girls know how to move! 🔥

Your events went without an echo? The people weren’t interested in visiting the club for the performance of your favorite DJ? With the new marketing tools you can make sure every single time the club will be FULL! 😎

Some people like to gamble, or simply play some arcade. With help of the new machines you’ll grab the attention of these guests as well! Make sure that your club has something to offer for everyone and you’ll make the money come your way! 💰

People think they can allow themselves to do more than it’s appropriate as soon as no one watches. With the help of CCTV you’ll be able to catch the instigators of problems and decrease the overall amount of incidents to make it through peacefully every single night! 🕺

A brand new branch to manage. 📝 You can manipulate your bar menu via supplies! Be careful not to run out of the booze in the middle of the night. It would be wise to offer a wider variety of alcohol to be able to meet everyone’s tastes. 🙂
Neons, disco balls and tons of lighting… All of these do cost money so make sure not to overload your electricity supplies. Otherwise the bills will make even the toughest managers shed a tear. 😢

notes.title: Are you hyped for the upcoming changes? Remember that the game is still developed and the final appearance of the features we have shown you may change 🤏 Would you like us to add some specific content? Or would you change something about the ones we described?

items.text: Make sure to let us know in the comments! 🤩
